sentences.text: This writ petition is filed by the petitioner, challenging seizure of food grains contained in plastic bags while in transit to the respective shops of the purchasers of rice from the petitioner, alleging it to be rationed articles.
Ext.P6 FIR is registered by the Parippally Police Station, Kollam District.

2. While matters being so, petitioner has submitted Ext.P8 before the District Collector challenging the action of seizure, which is pending in File No.DCKLM/1272/2019-M8, before the District Collector.

The sole relief sought for by the petitioner is adjudication of Ext.P8, also taking into account, the contentions raised by the petitioner that the District Collector has no power to entertain any aspects as per the rationing order in view of Section 97(2) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

3. When this writ petition was admitted to the files of this court, an interim stay of distribution of rise through Public Distribution System was granted for a period of one month, which was subsequently extended, and it is in force now.

4. Having considered the urgency of the matter and hearing respective counsel on either side, there will be a direction to the 1st respondent to finalize Ext.P8 application submitted by the petitioner specified above, at the earliest and at any rate, within a month from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment, after providing an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner or any other interested persons.
Till such time, the interim order granted by this court as specified above will continue to be in force.
The writ petition is disposed of, accordingly.
